children: Ethos Technologies said its systems weren't breached after its carrier partner, TruStage Financial, reported a service disruption in July.
The insurance technology company on Wednesday said that its own tech infrastructure was never compromised during the incident over the summer, adding that none of its data was extracted.

Ethos confirmed that customer policy cancellation rates remained stable through the disruption and that any effect of the incident was already accounted for in its third-quarter guidance which was released earlier in August.
